name: Hushen
body:
The hushen are proud tiger-folk who trace their ancestry to the sacred huntresses and tiger spirits sworn to eradicate demons. Bold, ferocious, and relentless in pursuit of prey, they excel as front-line warriors, stalkers, and demon hunters.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Hushen are remarkably strong and agile, but their predatory arrogance often irritates others. They gain +2 Strength, +2 Dexterity, and -2 Charisma.
Type: Humanoid (feline). Hushen are humanoids with the feline subtype.
Size: Medium. Hushen have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Fast Speed. Hushen have a base land speed of 40 feet.
Languages: Hushen begin play speaking Common. Bonus languages include Celestial, Draconic, Gnoll, Goblin, and Sylvan.
Senses and Offense Racial Traits
Low-Light Vision: Hushen can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Natural Weapons: A hushen gains two primary claw attacks dealing 1d4 points of slashing damage each (plus Strength modifier).
Demon Bane (Ex): Hushen gain a +1 racial bonus on attack and damage rolls against evil outsiders.
Pounce (Ex): When a hushen makes a charge, she can make a full attack with her natural weapons.
Skill Racial Traits
Feline Grace: Hushen receive a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Stealth checks.
